home.why_subtitle: WorkLink stands out with a professional, innovative approach, constantly adapting to the latest technological trends, offering a complete range of tailored digital services for freelancers and companies alike.
home.step1_desc: Our intelligent system analyzes skills, experience, and project needs to connect you with the most suitable professionals in seconds.
home.step2_desc: Post a project and start receiving qualified matches immediately — no long waiting times, no unnecessary steps, and no friction.
home.step3_desc: Narrow down results by skills, experience level, budget, location and availability. You stay informed and in control at every step.
home.step4_desc: We are constantly exploring new technologies to offer innovative, forward-thinking solutions so you stay competitive in a fast-evolving digital landscape.

home.fl_step2_desc: Explore missions published by companies and apply to the ones that match your profile.

home.co_step1_desc: Present your business and define your needs to attract the right freelancers.

home.co_step3_desc: Track applications, ongoing missions, and payments from your company dashboard.

home.cta_banner_text: freelancers seeking work, and companies looking to hire
home.modal_company_desc1: This interface is intended for business use only.
home.modal_company_desc2: Access is limited to verified companies. Please log in with a business account to continue.
home.modal_freelancer_desc1: This interface is intended for freelance professionals only.
home.modal_freelancer_desc2: Access is limited to verified freelancers. Please log in with a freelancer account to continue.
home.faq_a1: Worklink is designed for verified freelancers and companies. Access is limited to professional users to ensure quality, trust, and meaningful collaborations.
home.faq_q2: What makes Worklink different from other platforms?
home.faq_a2: Worklink focuses on quality over quantity. Unlike traditional platforms, it connects verified freelancers with serious clients, reduces noise, and offers tools designed to improve visibility and real work opportunities.
home.faq_a3: Yes, Worklink offers a free version with basic access. However, premium plans are available to unlock advanced features and the full potential of the platform.
home.faq_q4: How does Worklink help freelancers find work?
home.faq_a4: Worklink helps freelancers by matching their skills with relevant projects, improving their visibility to companies, and providing tools to connect directly with potential clients.
home.faq_q5: Are there limits on messages or applications?
home.faq_a5: Yes, the free plan includes limited messages and applications. Upgrading to a premium plan removes these limits and allows unlimited interactions.
home.faq_q6: Can we post job offers or projects?
home.faq_a6: Yes, companies can post job offers and projects to reach qualified freelancers quickly and efficiently.
home.faq_q7: Is there a rating or feedback system?
home.faq_a7: Yes, Worklink includes a rating and feedback system to promote transparency, build trust, and help users make informed decisions.
